recipes.title: Carnivore Protein Bread Loaf (also burger buns)

items.i: Heart & Soil unflavored whey protein powder
tallow or virgin coconut oil, melted (lukewarm)

steps: Whisk the eggs and yolks until smooth, then whisk in the Greek yogurt until fully combined.
In another bowl mix the whey, collagen, salt and baking soda. Add to the egg mixture, stirring gently at first, then whisk until smooth.
Mix in the lukewarm melted tallow until fully incorporated.
Grease a 16 × 10 × 6 cm loaf pan or glass dish with tallow or ghee and line with parchment. Pour in the batter, give one final gentle stir and level the top.
Bake at 190°C (375°F) for about 30 minutes, until golden and a toothpick comes out clean.
recipes.notes: From the cookbook pages you sent (pages 32–34). Other sizes use the same method: for 2 small burger buns use half of everything (2 eggs, 1 yolk, 45 g yogurt, 60 g whey, 15 g collagen, ½ tsp soda, ½ tbsp tallow) in 10.5 cm round greased, lined moulds, bake 15 min at 190°C (375°F) then 5 min at 165°C (330°F). For a family-size loaf use 1½ times everything (6 eggs, 3 yolks, 135 g yogurt, 180 g whey, 45 g collagen, 1½ tsp soda, 1½ tbsp tallow) in a 17 × 12 × 6.5 cm pan for about 35 minutes. The tallow/coconut oil keeps it moist and softer. The book gives no nutrition; the macros are my estimate for 8 slices of the regular loaf.
